Team — quick ask as we push to close Parallax this quarter. Lena and Tim at Parallax are in final procurement. They’ve asked for a modest incentive to commit to an annual pilot: a one-off token grant + a 30-day trial extension. Current proposal from Soojin (me): 75,000 tokens + 30-day extension conditioned on signature of pilot SOW and PO by Oct 15.

Why: expected ARR ~$140k first year if they convert. Sales cycle has stalled on usage limits; the token grant is a low-cost lever to remove friction. Finance rough calc: this is effectively $7–9k of unit economics at our marginal cost.

Request: please approve 75k token grant + 30-day trial extension and authorize me to send the customer the SOW + DocuSign link. I’ve attached the token authorization form for records. If you want a different structure (smaller token grant + extended credits), advise — need decision by EOD Friday so we can hit Oct 15 signature target.

Attachments: [Attachment: token-authorization-form.pdf (application/pdf)]
